rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for deliberately paying attention to sounds or speech.

example.english: Listen—do you hear anything at the door?
example.jyutping: nei5 teng1 haa5 mun4 hau2 jau5 mou5 seng1

rows.note: Use this when listening to a particular person means heeding or obeying what that person says.

example.english: Listen to me and don't go out again.
example.traditional: 你要聽我話，唔好再出街。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 teng1 ngo5 waa6 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 gaai1
